reuse.why: Collapses the five copied provider link functions into linkBankSyncAccount/linkOrgBankSyncAccount, generalises the Pluggy download into downloadSyncServerTransactions for Akahu and Fintegra, and reuses one clearBankLink for unlink and take-over.

duplication.why: Removes large existing duplication; only small residue remains (the institution-null comment block repeated in linkOrgBankSyncAccount and linkEnableBankingAccount, and the akahu/fintegra or-branch in processBankSyncDownload).

placement.why: Link-guard queries live in accounts/link.ts and orchestration in accounts/app.ts, but the guard is applied by wrapping handlers at app.method registration rather than inside the link flow, which separates the rule from the link functions.

scope.why: Delivers all four steps, but also rewrites every provider's link function and the Pluggy download, a broad refactor beyond what the requests asked for.

maintainability.why: One link path, one guard wrapper and one download helper make future providers trivial, at the cost of a per-provider getAccountId lambda at registration and a large one-shot change.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All six *-accounts-link handlers go through guardBankAccountLink and linkBankSyncAccount; unlinkAccount and take-over share clearBankLink.

disguised_duplication.where: No duplicated logic is disguised; residual repetition (institution block in app.ts) is open.

abstraction_drift.where: linkBankSyncAccount gained fileId (for Pluggy); guardBankAccountLink in app.ts carries one replaceExistingLink branch; no handler bypasses the guard or link helper.
